title: Command: inbox
lead:
`adj inbox` lists open questions, oldest first, with options and
recommendations.
findings_note: PROJECT.md Goals 2; v1 feature tier; Milestone 3
boundary: **Not in this slice:** a TUI or HTML inbox, and a cross-repo inbox (Later tier).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Goal 2: the owner answers every open question in one batch.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/commands/inbox.go`.
- `internal/render/inbox.go` (text) next to the JSON renderer from S08.
- `internal/cli/inbox_test.go`.
- `docs/json.md`: the `inbox --json` shape.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
End-to-end CLI tests call `cli.Run` in a fresh `t.TempDir()` store (with
`t.Chdir`, which rules out `t.Parallel`, or a root option the implementer adds
and records under C32), with a fixed clock where dates matter.

- Only `open` records appear, ordered by `created`, then by ID.
- Each entry shows its ID, title, every option (label and summary, and the
  tradeoffs when set) and the recommendation.
- An empty inbox exits 0 with an empty result in both text and JSON.
- `inbox --json` is byte-identical across two runs and matches `docs/json.md`.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Reuse the `query` filter with status `open`, sort oldest first, and render text
and JSON. The text layout and the JSON shape are implementer decisions recorded
under C32; document the shape in `docs/json.md`.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
Run from the repo root after `. scripts/env.sh` (the in-repo cache env, C33;
use the equivalent AGENTS.md names if S02 chose another):

- `go test ./...` passes, including this slice's new tests.
- `go vet ./...` reports nothing.
- `gofmt -l cmd internal` prints nothing (not `gofmt -l .`, which also walks
  `.cache/` and `.worktrees/`).
- Each interface choice made in this slice is a slicer catalog decision with a
  one-line reason (C32).
- `slicer check --json` is clean.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body:
Worktree under `.worktrees/` on a feature branch. No commit unless the owner
asks; no AI attribution.
